title: A government portal moves the founder's live application

objects.subject: Application SSR-2026-48213: status updated
objects.body:
Dear Applicant,

Your application SSR-2026-48213 for recognition under the StartupSetu programme has moved to the stage: Under Examination. You will be notified when the examination is complete. Track the status on the StartupSetu portal.

Regards,
StartupSetu Team

decision_states.subject: recognition application SSR-2026-48213
decision_states.quote: has moved to the stage: Under Examination

not_expressible.workstream: STEP-09 — the engine forms no workstream; nothing to compare against
not_expressible.stage: STEP-09 — no stage is derived for a workstream

notes: The faithful junk-filter answer to an automated portal notice is drop: the prompt says to drop automated, self-service notices, and nothing in it says the founder has a live application. That gap is the engine's (STEP-03, STEP-04).
blocked_on: the portal's status notice is kept and read now (STEP-07, W-07: the company brief's watchlist names the portal) and reaches memory — but no situation forms about the application, only the period reviews; an application in motion is a workstream — STEP-09
